import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

def demonstrate_imputation():
    # Create sample data with missing values
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'age': [25, 30, np.nan, 45, 35, np.nan, 28, 40],
        'salary': [50000, 60000, 55000, np.nan, 70000, 45000, np.nan, 80000],
        'score': [85.5, np.nan, 92.0, 78.5, 88.0, np.nan, 95.0, 70.0]
    })
    
    print("Original DataFrame:")
    print(df)
    print(f"\nMissing values:\n{df.isnull().sum()}")
    
    # Mean imputation
    mean_imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
    df_mean = pd.DataFrame(
        mean_imputer.fit_transform(df),
        columns=df.columns
    )
    
    print("\nMean Imputation:")
    print(df_mean.round(2))
    
    # Median imputation
    median_imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='median')
    df_median = pd.DataFrame(
        median_imputer.fit_transform(df),
        columns=df.columns
    )
    
    print("\nMedian Imputation:")
    print(df_median.round(2))
    
    # Compare statistics
    print("\nOriginal means:", df.mean().to_dict())
    print("Mean-imputed means:", df_mean.mean().to_dict())

demonstrate_imputation()
